item.title: Peltz’s Trian Offers $1.4 Billion to Take Wendy’s Private
item.description: Nelson Peltz’s Trian Fund Management offered to buy out Wendy’s Co. for about $1.4 billion, saying the burger chain will be better off attempting a multiyear turnaround bid as a private company.

item.title: Deutsche Telekom Is Said to Hit Brakes on Giant T-Mobile Merger
item.description: Deutsche Telekom AG’s plans to combine with its American arm T-Mobile US Inc. have hit a snag, people familiar with the matter said, casting doubt on what would be the largest-ever public merger.

item.title: Fed's Warsh Says Monetary 'Medicine' Starting to Work
item.description: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh says there are no firm conclusions right now about monetary policy during a news conference after the central bank's policy-setting Federal Open Market Committee decided to leave rates unchanged. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Fed Will Raise Rates in December, Clarida Predicts
item.description: Former Federal Reserve Vice Chairman Richard Clarida expects the Fed to raise rates in December and then possibly again in March. He speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance: The Fed Decides." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Chris Wright Says Diesel Exports From Arabian Gulf Likely to Increase
item.description: Energy Secretary Chris Wright said that he expects diesel prices to be 'dropped significantly' but will need increased exports out of the Arabian Gulf to manage it amid the ongoing war with Iran. Wright also Russia's diesel output, saying that the only way Russia can benefit from recently permitted exports of diesel is to deliver a ceasefire on energy or end the war. (Source: Bloomberg)
